item.text: The implementations now normalize scalar or array input in each backend. Redis removes each requested value, MongoDB uses `$pull` with `$in`, and PostgreSQL filters the array with ordinality so surviving items keep their original order. I added a database test that checks multiple removals, duplicate occurrences, order, and an immediate read.
